data: Avec ses potes, Rémi fait n'importe quoi... Pour devenir n'importe qui. Mais Sandra, sa copine, aimerait qu'il devienne quelqu'un. Et il y arrive quand même un peu. (With his pals, Rémi does anything... To become nothing in particular. But Sandra, his girlfriend, would like him to become someone. And he even manages to do so just a little bit.)

With his pals, Rémi does anything... To become nothing in particular. But Sandra, his girlfriend, would like him to become someone. And he even manages to do so just a little bit.
